en.headline: Man injured in Tsim Sha Tsui bottle attack; two men taken in
en.dek: A middle-aged man was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital after being struck on the head outside a bar on Minden Avenue early Tuesday.
body: Police are investigating an assault in Tsim Sha Tsui after a middle-aged man was attacked with a beer bottle outside a bar on Minden Avenue in the early hours of Tuesday.

Officers and ambulance crews were called shortly after 4.50am to reports of a fight outside Nos. 13 to 15 Minden Avenue. A man aged about 50 was found with a head wound. He was conscious and was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Local media reported that the man had been drinking at an upstairs bar and was set upon by several men as he left the building. Broken glass and blood were left on the pavement.

At about 6am, officers stopped a seven-seater vehicle on Tseung Kwan O Road near the Lam Tin flyover at Lin Tak Road. Five men were in the vehicle. Police later took two of them away. Officers sealed the scene and said they were investigating the circumstances and looking for those involved.
Police have not announced formal charges. The case remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀棉登徑男子遭玻璃樽襲擊 兩人被帶走
zh.dek: 約50歲男子周二凌晨在樓上酒吧外頭部受傷，清醒送伊利沙伯醫院，警方其後截查七人車。
body: 警方正調查尖沙咀一宗傷人案。一名中年男子周二凌晨在棉登徑一間酒吧外，懷疑被人用啤酒玻璃樽擊中頭部。
凌晨約4時50分，警方及救護員接報指棉登徑13至15號外有人打架，發現一名約50歲男子頭部受傷，當時清醒，被送往伊利沙伯醫院治理。本地傳媒報道，事主較早前在樓上酒吧消遣，離開大廈時遭數名男子襲擊，行人路遺下玻璃碎片及血迹。
約上午6時，警員在將軍澳隧道公路近藍田連德道天橋截查一輛七人車，車上有五名男子，其後帶走其中兩人。警方封鎖現場，調查遇襲經過，並追緝涉案人士。
警方尚未公布有人被正式落案，案件仍在調查中。
